name: drivelux-motors
description: A premium, fully responsive car dealership website built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion, featuring luxury vehicle showcases, financing plans, test drive booking, customer testimonials, and a modern automotive UI.

paragraphs: A premium, fully responsive car dealership website built for luxury automotive showrooms, vehicle dealerships, and premium car brands. Developed with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion, the website showcases luxury vehicles, financing options, instant car valuation, test drive booking, customer support, and a modern automotive-inspired UI.

DriveLux Motors was designed to help premium car dealerships establish a strong digital presence while providing customers with an engaging platform to explore luxury vehicles, financing solutions, and dealership services.

Visitors can browse featured inventory, discover vehicle categories, compare financing plans, use an instant car valuation tool, schedule a test drive, and contact the dealership through a modern responsive interface.
